content: Kimi (Moonshot AI) is OpenAI-compatible. Base URL https://api.moonshot.ai/v1 (China: api.moonshot.cn); chat endpoint POST {base}/chat/completions. Auth: Authorization: Bearer $MOONSHOT_API_KEY. Model IDs: moonshot-v1-8k/32k/128k, kimi-k2.5, kimi-k2.6, kimi-k3 (flagship as of mid-2026), kimi-k2.7-code. Supports streaming, tool/function calling, JSON mode via standard OpenAI SDK compatible surface.
